title: Warm Flaky Korean Lettuce Dumplings
description: A rich and cozy Korean dish featuring lettuce, wok-hei, and Mediterranean-friendly flavors, wrapped in a warm flaky dough.
instructions: Combine flour and ice cold water in a large mixing bowl to make the dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll each ball into a thin circle.
Heat sesame oil in a large wok over medium high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped lettuce and green onions, and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the lettuce mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Cook the dumplings in the wok for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings warm with additional soy sauce and sesame oil if desired.
